newsitem.title: BELGIUM: West Europe new car registrations down 5.2 pct yr-yr Nov. [CORRECTED 09:06 GMT]
newsitem.headline: West Europe new car registrations down 5.2 pct yr-yr Nov. [CORRECTED 09:06 GMT]

text.p: West European new car registrations dropped 5.2 percent year-on-year in November but rose 6.4 percent in the year-to-date compared to last year, the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) said in a statement on Thursday.
(Corrects to read the figure for Nov year-on-year growth as minus 5.2 percent. The 6.4 percent figure refers to year-to-date growth in new registrations.)
ACEA said 903,300 new cars were registered for all brands of car sold in the European Union, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein during November this year.
